evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Native pipeline vocabulary deployed with precision: 'receipt,' 'blocking call,' 'drops the receipt' — jargon used as contract terms, not explained for outsiders.

evidence.quote:
remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Dense native jargon — 'dispatches,' 'polls the run,' 'reaction piggybacked' — used as shorthand among peers, no accessibility concession.
